responsibility: This file implements procedural lookup of Unicode box-drawing glyphs for the text-art subsystem. It owns the runtime mapping from a directions value to a cppchar_t by indexing the generated table from box-drawing-chars.inc, giving higher-level renderers such as themes a stable helper for turning abstract line connectivity into concrete Unicode line-art characters; it also contains focused selftests for that mapping.
same_name_distinction: Implements the declared box-drawing API by defining the generated-table-backed lookup logic and this stem’s selftests; unlike gcc/text-art/box-drawing.h, it is the runtime definition site rather than the interface declaration.
